what_changed_since_v3.1.19_candidate: Performance repairs from the smooth-play pass (v3.1.20-SP/v3.1.21-SP lineage, never published): measured on this build in a headed real-GPU browser, district 1189 frames median 16.7 ms / p95 16.8 ms / max 83.5 ms and mall 1215 frames median 16.7 / p95 16.8 / max 49.9 ms at 1584x805 DPR 1, 20 s walk with normal input, no competing heavy browser job. Not a combat-load benchmark.
Claw hammer tool (barricade boards/nails, pry) with first-draw warm-up and its fill light preserved across map switches.

Glass three states (owner spec RAW-20260915-002): intact -> legacy cracked-glass texture on the first shot (small impact crack contained in the pane) -> pane disappears on the second shot, edge remnants kept, New Game restores panes. Includes horizontal mall skylights.
Meridian Mall map (WIP.11) selectable from New Game alongside the District.
Results-screen held-input guard (GUARD-01): holding Space/Enter through the end of a run leaves the results screen visible; release plus one fresh press starts exactly one new run.
FIX-22: the game version no longer gets replaced by the mall's map label; District is the default map; hammer fill light survives map rebuild.
known_residuals_disclosed: Zombie window breach: zombies can break barricade boards (slow; roughly two minutes for one walker) but pass through a cleared opening with an instant snap, and there is NO visible climb/vault animation (owner clarification RAW-20260915-004 preserved as follow-up scope). No live zombie breach trace was completed on this build.

Enemy access to the mall upper floor: in a native pursuit trace none of 22 enemies reached the upper floor while the player waited 27 s in the upper record shop (navigation ends at escalator bottoms). Repair drafted locally, not included.
Board accounting: building spends 2 boards while a barricade has 3 board slots; repeated build/pry can return unearned boards (owner report E07). Repair drafted locally, not included.

Mall combat frame pacing under enemy load is not benchmarked; a functional mall pursuit trace showed the HUD at 10 FPS during parts of pursuit (cause unprofiled). 60 fps remains a target, not a verified claim, under heavy combat.
Hammer HUD/model mismatch report (E05) not re-verified; the hammer drew cleanly in the final check on both maps.
First glass crack adds about +2 shader programs and the first gunshot about +5 (possible one-time hitch).
Mall upper railings are opaque, not glass (E03); mall shops are sparsely furnished and loot is not yet container-appropriate (MPT11-D); rear hallway empty (Mall v3 brief).
Held-Space results guard verified live on the death results screen; extraction uses the same endRun/guard path in source, but a live held-Space extraction was not re-run on this exact build.
Bosses/specials balance, hunting-rifle/reload audio and MP5/M4A1 secondary-audio contention (ZSS-BUG-029) unchanged/open. Load time not optimized.
Apartment bed/door approach: passes for player radius <= 0.50; larger enemy radius 0.60 cannot fit that aperture.
Changelog reconciliation (459 unclassified commits) is outstanding; it is a wall-close gate, not a publish gate.
All remaining MPT11-A..G owner specifications stay preserved for later work.
